lines.content: - Sitemap coverage confirmed: all 22 currently-built pages (4 static + 18 docs) present in `dist/sitemap-0.xml`, zero duplicates, zero missing.
- `npx astro check` (0 errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), `npx vitest run` (208 tests), and `npm run build:check` (still-live Vite pipeline) all pass.

- Next: Phase 5 (home/app page WASM wiring) — this is largely already verified working (Phase 3's Playwright check ran a full solve), so Phase 5 is mostly a confirmation/hardening pass rather than new work: double-check WebMCP forms stay outside any island boundary, verify `webmcp.ts`/`worker.ts` need no further changes. Then Phase 6 (explainer islands) is the next real chunk of new work.

- **Phase 5 (home/app page WASM wiring) — confirmed, no code changes needed.** `worker.ts`, `webmcp.ts`, `teeline-wasm.d.ts` all diff byte-identical against `master` (zero changes since Phase 0). `index.astro` has zero `client:*` directives anywhere on the page — `BaseLayout`, `FeatureCards`, `AlgorithmCards` are all plain server-rendered Astro components with no hydration boundary at all, so the WebMCP hidden forms (plain sibling HTML, not nested in any component) trivially satisfy the "must stay in static, non-hydrated output" constraint. Full solve flow was already verified end-to-end in Phase 3. Nothing to commit for this phase.

- Next: Phase 6 (explainer islands) — `src/pages/algorithms/[id]/explainer/index.astro` dynamic route, wire all 10 `.tsx` explainer components with `client:visible`, delete the 10 `*-page.ts` mount scripts.
